Case Study 01

Proven Locks

Proven Locks has been a QCK client for an extended period. Rankings and traffic built steadily and accelerated over the past year. The account now shows AI Overview placements, a visibility surface that had negligible presence a year prior. Organic revenue is a six-figure-per-month contributor for the business.
Case Study 02

Martinez Tools

Client since late March 2026. Data below includes a decline in branded search alongside growth in non-branded traffic.
+267%
Organic sessions, last 3 months vs. prior 3
-31.5K
Branded term clicks, "martinez hammer," 3 months vs. prior 3 months
10.6K
Total GSC clicks, last 3 months (8.15K same period last year)
+226%
Google organic revenue attribution, 90-day year over year (client backend)
Non-branded organic clicks are higher than the same period last year, and total page-1 keyword coverage has grown since the engagement began. Branded search demand has declined since December 5, a trend visible in both top queries and homepage traffic. QCK is scoping paid and email support to address this directly.
GA4 was not fully instrumented before this engagement, and full access has not yet been granted, so QCK cannot report platform-attributed organic revenue for this account. The client's backend shows Google organic revenue up 226% over the trailing 90 days versus the same period last year.
Case Study 03

Terraslate

Engaged May 2025 to June 2026. Paused when the client redirected resources to fulfill order volume.
12K
Peak monthly organic traffic (Ahrefs estimate)
+51.4%
Key events, YTD vs. comparable prior period
+25.5%
Total organic revenue, YTD vs. comparable prior period
Terraslate's product, waterproof paper, is not seasonal, which makes a year-to-date comparison a direct read on the period. Strategy was focused on commercial terms and use-case content. Sessions grew modestly while key events and revenue grew more, indicating higher-intent traffic.
The engagement paused in June 2026 when Terraslate redirected internal resources to fulfill order volume. Search Console access is no longer available; the GA4 data above reflects the current reporting access.

Koia's strategy has centered on use-case category pages. Since the engagement began in late December 2025, non-branded organic clicks are approximately three times the same period last year, and AI Overview placements grew from a near-zero base to over 1,600. GA4 organic revenue is up 74.2% year-over-year.

Four accounts, four verticals. We move the needle, QCK-ly.
